task_description: The agents need to collaboratively gather information from various online sources, synthesize the collected data, and produce a comprehensive research report on the impact of climate change on global food security.
expected_outcome: If everything works correctly, the agents will produce an accurate and well-referenced research report that integrates findings from multiple sources and resolves any conflicting data.

agents.description: This agent searches online databases and scientific publications to collect relevant information on climate change and food security.
This agent validates the data collected by Agent 1 to ensure it is from credible sources and correct.
This agent synthesizes data from validated sources, resolving any conflicts and producing a coherent dataset.
This agent generates the research report, ensuring proper referencing of sources.
This agent reviews the final report for accuracy, consistency, and source attribution.

content.report_draft: draft report with incorrect data integration
